name: frontdesk
description: Frontdesk - Customer Support Ticket Management System for Arvo Systems

scripts.install:all: npm install --prefix server && npm install --prefix client
scripts.db:use-postgres: powershell -Command "Copy-Item server/prisma/schema.postgresql.prisma server/prisma/schema.prisma -Force; cd server; npx prisma generate"
scripts.db:use-sqlite: powershell -Command "Copy-Item server/prisma/schema.sqlite.prisma server/prisma/schema.prisma -Force; cd server; npx prisma generate"

author: Arvo Systems Engineering
